description: Get the latest run status for a test script replay workflow runtime. A replay short ID such as R-2051 resolves to that replay's workflow runtime, and the tool returns that runtime's latest run.

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) the short ID belongs to. Required when a short ID is given; ignored for a full ID.

workflowRuntimeId.description: Replay workflow runtime ID (UUID), or the replay's short ID, e.g. R-2051. Use the `workflowRuntimeId` returned when the workflow was started — not a run `id` or a test runs summary's `latestWorkflowRunId`, which are run ids and are not found here.

name: muggle-remote-wf-get-ts-replay-latest-run
